# QECTOR Decoder v3 (v0.6.9)

> Python and Rust quantum error correction decoder package for QEC research, decoder validation, reproducible artifacts, and commercial evaluation.

QECTOR Decoder v3 is distributed on PyPI as `qector-decoder-v3==0.6.9`. 

Algorithms: UnionFind, FastUnionFind, Blossom MWPM (exact PyMatching LER parity), SparseBlossom, BeliefMatching (+35.7% LER reduction at d=5 under depolarizing circuit noise), BpOsd / BPOSD (qLDPC), BatchDecoder, CUDABatchDecoder / OpenCLBatchDecoder, AutoDecoder (7-tier fallback), HybridDecoder, PredecodedDecoder, LookupTableDecoder, SlidingWindowDecoder, StreamingDecoder, and GNNBeliefMatcher.

## Recommended install command

pip install qector-decoder-v3==0.6.9

## Boundaries & Licensing

- Free academic, personal, and non-commercial research use.
- Commercial production use requires a commercial licence.
- All numeric benchmark claims link to reproducible artifacts and local benchmark harnesses.
